eventDetail.scope: BioCAS 2024 is a IEEE CASS flagship conference and a premier international forum for presenting interdisciplinary research and development activities at the crossroads of medicine, life sciences, physical sciences and engineering that shape tomorrow's medical devices and healthcare systems. This conference brings together members of our communities to broaden their knowledge in emerging areas of research at the interface of life sciences and circuits and systems engineering.
